recipe_version.title: Baked Ziti with Italian Sausage
recipe_version.description: Ziti tossed in a garlicky crushed-tomato and browned Italian sausage sauce with mozzarella, layered with pockets of basil-seasoned ricotta, topped with more mozzarella and Parmesan, and baked until bubbling and golden.

ingredients.name: Italian sausage
ingredients.display_name: sweet or hot Italian pork sausage

ingredients.name: red pepper flakes
ingredients.note: use 1/2 tsp with sweet sausage if you like heat

ingredients.name: low-moisture mozzarella
ingredients.note: 2 cups shredded: 1 cup tossed with the pasta, 1 cup on top

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.note: about 1 oz finely grated: 1/4 cup in the pasta, 1/4 cup on top

ingredients.name: fresh basil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp in the ricotta, 2 tbsp to finish

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp for the pasta water, 1/2 tsp for the sauce, 1/4 tsp for the ricotta

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for boiling the pasta; reserve 1/2 cup

steps.title: Heat the oven and prep
steps.body: Set a rack in the upper-middle position and heat the oven to 400°F; it preheats during prep and the sauce (about 37 minutes before the bake; overlap stated). Bring 4 quarts water with 1 tbsp salt to a boil in a large covered pot. Dice the onion, mince the garlic, shred the mozzarella, and grate the Parmesan. Stir the ricotta with 1/4 tsp salt, the pepper, and 2 tbsp torn basil.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.body: Heat the olive oil in a 12-inch deep skillet or 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high. Add the sausage and break it into bite-size pieces; cook until well browned and no longer pink, 6 to 7 minutes.

steps.title: Add the aromatics
steps.body: Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes. Add the garlic, oregano, and red pepper flakes and stir 30 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.body: Add the crushed tomatoes and 1/2 tsp salt. Simmer gently, stirring now and then, until slightly thickened, about 12 minutes. Taste for salt.

steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.body: While the sauce simmers, add the ziti to the boiling water and cook 2 minutes less than the package's al dente time (about 8 minutes); it finishes in the oven. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain. Runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Combine and layer
steps.body: Off heat, stir the ziti into the sauce with 1 cup mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan, adding a splash of pasta water if it looks tight. Spread half in a 9x13-inch (3-quart) baking dish, dollop the ricotta mixture over in spoonfuls, and cover with the rest of the pasta. Scatter the remaining 1 cup mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan over the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake uncovered on the upper-middle rack until bubbling at the edges and the cheese is melted with golden-brown spots, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.body: Rest 5 minutes so it holds together, then scatter the remaining 2 tbsp torn basil. kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.heat: Medium-high to brown, gentle simmer for the sauce, 400°F oven upper-middle rack (preheat overlaps prep and sauce).
recipe_version.doneness: Sausage browned with no pink. Pasta just under al dente before baking, tender after. Sauce bubbling at the edges; mozzarella melted with golden-brown spots; ricotta pockets creamy. kitchen_tested is false.
